title: Wokwi diagram.json
description: Minimal JSON Schema for validating the diagram.json file produced by the DeMoL Wokwi code generator. The schema is a strict subset of the Wokwi diagram format (https://docs.wokwi.com/diagram-format) and intentionally allows additional optional fields (e.g. top/left/attrs metadata on parts) to remain forward-compatible with the Wokwi simulator.

version.description: Diagram format version. The current Wokwi format is v1.

author.description: Author/owner of the diagram. Set to 'demol' by the DeMoL generator.

editor.description: Editor identifier. Set to 'wokwi' by the DeMoL generator.

parts.description: List of parts placed on the Wokwi breadboard (controller + peripherals).

id.description: Local instance id used as a reference target in 'connections'.

attrs.description: Free-form per-part attributes (pin overrides, colour, etc.).

prefixItems.description: Optional list of wire override colours (empty array == use default).
